title: Chicken Leg Rings 1-100 Numbered Chicken Identification Leg Bands Tags Reusable For Ducks Chicks Chicken Pigeons Goose Green
body_html: 1、Package Content: The package comes with 100 pieces chicken leg bands, number ranging from 1 to 100, enough quantity to use. The numbers can help you quickly distinguish your poultry. 2、Find Animal Quickly: With number marks, the poultry foot rings allow people to classify different breeds easily and distinguish noisy animals quickly, offering a good guard to most animals from being bullied. 3、PP Material: Chicken leg rings are made of PP material, which are reusable and safe to use. Chicken leg rings are very sturdy and not easy to break, you can use our chicken bands repeatedly for a long time. 4、Easy to Use: Chicken leg rings are easy to apply and remove. The rings will help you easily keep different breeds apart without need of any tools, and each band is reusable to meet your need. 5、Wide Application: Poultry leg rings can be applied in poultry management operating or breeding.
